updates.text: Initial board: 37 prospects across QB, RB, WR and TE, with starting draft-range and production estimates.

prospects.name: Jeremiah Smith
prospects.note: Unanimous All-American in 2025; holds Buckeye career receiving records. Near-unanimous WR1.

prospects.name: Cam Coleman
prospects.note: Former five-star; transferred from Auburn. Widely viewed as WR2 in the class.

prospects.name: Charlie Becker
prospects.note: Led the Big Ten at 20.0 yards per catch in 2025.

prospects.name: KJ Duff
prospects.note: 2025: 60 catches, 1,084 yards, 7 TD.

prospects.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
prospects.note: Formerly Ryan Williams. Explosive freshman year; young for the class.

prospects.name: Mario Craver
prospects.note: Smaller, dynamic slot/vertical threat.

prospects.name: Eric Singleton Jr.
prospects.note: Early-round possibility despite inconsistent QB play.

prospects.name: Nick Marsh
prospects.note: 2025: 59 catches, 662 yards. Strong at contested catches.

prospects.name: Ryan Wingo
prospects.note: Former five-star; drops were an issue in 2025.

prospects.name: Reed Harris
prospects.note: 800 yards, 8 TD through his first seven games of 2026.

prospects.name: Wyatt Young
prospects.note: 2025 (North Texas): 1,264 yards, 10 TD.

prospects.name: Deuce Alexander
prospects.note: Big-play threat; transferred from Wake Forest.

prospects.name: Junior Sherrill
prospects.note: Mid-round prospect with early-round upside.

prospects.name: Kewan Lacy
prospects.note: Several draft analysts rank him RB1. Speed back.

prospects.name: Ahmad Hardy
prospects.note: Led the SEC in rushing in 2025 and the nation in 15+ yard runs.

prospects.name: Jadan Baugh
prospects.note: 1,170 rushing yards in 2025. Big, balanced runner.

prospects.name: Nate Frazier
prospects.note: Power plus open-field speed.

prospects.name: Raleek Brown
prospects.note: 1,141 rushing yards at Arizona State in 2025.

prospects.name: Drew Mestemaker
prospects.note: Rose from borderline first-rounder to QB1 on some big boards this fall.

prospects.name: Arch Manning
prospects.note: Ideal build and athleticism; 2026 season has been uneven.

prospects.name: Dante Moore
prospects.note: Returned to Oregon rather than enter the 2026 draft.

prospects.name: Julian Sayin
prospects.note: Very efficient starter throwing to Jeremiah Smith.

prospects.name: LaNorris Sellers
prospects.note: Rushing upside helps in fantasy.

prospects.name: Trey'Dez Green
prospects.note: Big target; some evaluators expect him to be TE1.

prospects.name: Jamari Johnson
prospects.note: Most NFL-ready TE per many evaluators; tough after the catch.

prospects.name: Garrett Oakley
prospects.note: Size, athleticism and blocking.

prospects.name: Hayden Hansen
prospects.note: Big in-line tight end.
